source: ISPR / Radio Pakistan / Dawn / Express Tribune / Arab News — August 27, 2026
delta: Aug 20: security forces kill 5 Fitna al-Hindustan militants in a Killi Suran, Panjgur IBO. Aug 21: ISPR announces 49 militants killed in a wave of high-tempo IBOs across KP and Balochistan; PM Shehbaz Sharif and President Zardari commend the operations. Aug 27: fresh IBOs kill 11 more militants — 2 in Bannu, 5 in Ladha (South Waziristan), and 4 in Sasool, Khuzdar (Balochistan, with drone support); Zardari says eliminating terrorists 'operating with foreign backing' is essential for national security. No formal ceasefire, no Urumqi Round 2 meeting confirmed; conflict remains in active low-intensity escalation.
